{{Top|leg}}
The '''kyrf plantation''' on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Korbin]] was owned by [[Drelmar Bin]]. It cultivated the native [[kyrf]] [[Fruit/Legends|fruit]], and distilled it into a [[Kyrf (liquor)|liquor]] also called kyrf. It was located ten [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] from [[Pleasant City]], and covered 900 square kilometers.
